text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In preparation for the Shuka Sho, Sweep Tosho proposes a more rigorous training schedule than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see in her eyes a fierce determination to win first place. Respecting that drive, I decide to spend the next two weeks immersed in training with her.
